title: Prompt adherence evaluation
hook: Did it listen? What a CLIP-style score says, what a checklist says, and why the two pictures here tie on a total and differ on everything else.

verified.claim: CLIPScore uses w = 2.5 and clips negatives. The authors saw cosines from about 0 to 0.4.
TIFA turns a prompt into questions answered by a question-answering model.
CLIPTextEncode and CLIPVisionEncode are nodes in core.
Toy scores, ranks and the table's totals come from the lab.
The two pictures were looked at for this lesson, and the marks are one reader's.

unchecked: No CLIP model was run here, so every cosine in the lab is from made-up vectors.
Binding as a weak spot of real encoders is widely reported, and we did not test it or cite a measurement.
Whether a given pack's score is comparable to another's was not checked.
